team: Both of you finished the first sim with all 8 stations: Fred 1:11:10, Will 1:19:44. Fred was faster on 7 of 8 stations, Will won wall balls by 49 s (2:06 vs 2:55) and kept his first 7 runs within 17 s, but his knee is now the number one job.

fred.headline: First 8 station sim: legs are the limiter
fred.summary: Monday, Tuesday, Friday (done Thursday) and the sim done; no hockey logged, knee 0 all week. Run km 13 of the 13 km core target before Sunday's zone 2 run, and average RPE 8.0 vs 7.8 last week. The sim was 1:11:10 at RPE 8: runs 6:14 and 6:10 to start, then 6:50 after burpee broad jumps and 6:56 after lunges, while the run after the farmers carry was 6:20, exactly what you wrote about your legs.
strengths: Sleds at your 250 / 170 lb sim weight scale to about 2:28 push and 3:53 pull at race distance, both ahead of the 2:34 and 4:13 goal splits (at about 75% of race weight).
Tuesday 5 x 1 km averaged 5:45/km, right on target, and you noted your breathing was calmer than usual.
Recovery is improving: you are back to running pace 150 to 250 m after a station, where early sims burnt you out for the whole run.
weaknesses: Burpee broad jumps 3:02 for 40 m and sandbag lunges 2:56 for 48 m scale to about 6:04 and 6:06 at race distance vs 4:19 and 4:21 goal: about 3:30 lost on two stations.
Runs average 6:35/km vs the 5:53 goal pace and faded 46 s from run 2 to run 8; SkiErg (about 4:44 vs 4:15) and farmers (1:31 for 96 m, about 3:09 vs 1:50) also behind.
Friday: DB bench reps fell to 8, 6, 7 at RIR 0, and the hammer curls and wall ball technique sets were skipped (0/3, 0/2).
tips: Wall balls (your stated weakness, 2:55 for 50 today vs 2:30 last week): for Friday's 150, set feet just wider than shoulders with toes slightly out, ball high under the chin with elbows under it, about an arm's length from the wall, eyes on one spot on the target, and sit straight down with heels flat. The daily ankle rocks are what keep the heels down, so keep them going.

The fix for the burpee and lunge fade is now in the plan: DB walking lunges on Monday (start about 25 lb per hand, then one dumbbell step once all sets are RIR 2+), tired legs reps on Tuesday, and 100 m of lunges on Friday. Leave the station at a controlled jog for the first 200 m, then build, like you described.

Body weight averaged 157.0 lb vs 160.1 last week: 3.1 lb in one week, though about 1 lb a week over the two weeks since week 4 (159.0). If it drops more than 1.5 lb again next week, your own cut rule says eat a bit more, especially with Monday at RPE 9 and bench at RIR 0. Also edit Thursday's Friday log: it saved 170 min because the timer kept running.

tweaks.text: 5 x 1 km at about 5:45/km with 90 s rest; reps 2 and 4 follow the burpee broad jumps and lunges, so aim to keep them within 10 s of the others.
Keep the EMOM at last Monday's loads (sled push 235 lb, lunges 44 lb) until you log 10 s or more; farmers back to 53 lb per hand since you had 10 s left at 44.

will.headline: Knee again: get it checked
will.summary: Monday, Friday (done Tuesday), the Tuesday run (logged Thursday) and the sim done; no hockey logged. Run km 13 of the 13 km core target. The sim was 1:19:44 at RPE 7 with knee 3/10, after 6/10 on Thursday's run and 7/10 last Saturday, so the knee has been sore for two weeks.
strengths: Wall balls 2:06 for 50 in the sim (about 4:12 per 100 vs a 5:33 goal), the best station split on the team.
Even pacing: sim runs 1 to 7 between 6:49 and 7:06, and the 1 km reps 6:47 to 6:32 within 15 s.
Friday fully done: assisted pull-up 55 lb at RIR 2, DB bench 50 lb at RIR 1, and trap bar 235 lb at RIR 2 two Mondays running.
weaknesses: Right knee: 7, then 6, then 3 out of 10 in a week. That is over the 4/10 stop line twice and it keeps coming back.
Sandbag lunges 5:00 for 48 m and burpee broad jumps 3:53 for 40 m scale to about 10:24 and 7:46 at race distance vs 4:21 and 4:19 goal; both load the knee.
Runs average 7:06/km vs the 5:53 goal pace and run 8 dropped to 7:59; the arms block was skipped on Tuesday (0/4).
tips: Get the knee assessed by a physio this week, before the week 9 full sim. Until then, no running, lunges or broad jumps on any day it is 4/10 or more; this week's plan swaps the lunges for step ups.
Fix Tuesday's log: it saved 240 min and RPE 2 because the timer ran for almost 11 hours. Then do the arms block this Tuesday, it is the only lateral raise and curl work of the week.
Pull ups: you did 3/3 at RIR 2 with 55 lb of assistance, so drop the assistance to 50 lb on Friday.

tweaks.text: If the knee is 4/10 or more on Saturday, do the sim with step ups 20 per leg instead of the sandbag lunges, or log a rest day; never lunge through it.
Assisted pull-up at 50 lb of assistance (55 was RIR 2), and Friday is the 150 wall balls only, no lunge block this week.

mon.why: Right knee 7/10 after Saturday's sim: hack squat out, step ups instead of lunges, until the knee is back under 4.
